sb_prompt: FIND OUT WHAT THE OTHER CALLER'S FAVORITE TV SHOWS ARE AND WHY.  ARE YOUR INTERESTS SIMILAR OR DIFFERENT?
raw_output:
ParticipantA: Hello!
ParticipantB: Hello!
ParticipantB: Yeah, hi. Who's this?
ParticipantA: Just a random caller. I got the number from the list. Are you open to chatting?
ParticipantB: Sure, why not. What's up?
ParticipantA: So, I was told to ask about TV. What are your favorite shows?
ParticipantB: Hmm, that's easy. I like "Stranger Things" a lot. The kids are cool, you know?
ParticipantA: Stranger Things? Okay. I don't really get into that stuff. My favorite is probably "The Office" reruns.
ParticipantB: Really? Why that one? It's kind of old.
ParticipantA: Well, it's just funny in a real way. People act awkward, but it's true. Makes me laugh when I'm working the line.
ParticipantB: Oh, I've seen "The Office." I think it's a bit much sometimes. Like, the crying scenes get too sad for me.
ParticipantA: Oh? Why's that? It's not that deep.
ParticipantB: Yeah, it is. Last year my cousin broke up with her girlfriend on a bus, just like in one episode. I felt kinda sick watching it.
ParticipantA: Oh wow. That's personal. I guess I'm just numb to it now. Been watching it for years, maybe too long.
ParticipantB: Yeah, I'm not sure about that. Some stuff hits different. Like "Yellowjackets."
ParticipantA: "Yellowjackets"? I haven't heard of that. Is it scary?
ParticipantB: Kinda. It's about this girl's team at a factory, wait no, a soccer team, but they end up in the woods. Survivors.
ParticipantA: Oh, right. I heard something about that. It sounds intense. I prefer lighter stuff.
ParticipantB: Yeah, I get that. I like "Brooklyn Nine-Nine." Everyone's just being themselves, no drama.
ParticipantA: Yeah, that's my speed. Happy people, funny jokes. Nothing too heavy.
ParticipantB: See, I like that too, but sometimes I just want to watch something real. Like the show about the factory workers?
ParticipantA: Oh, "The Job"? Not really. I'm a supervisor there, to be honest. Hard to watch yourself on TV sometimes.
ParticipantB: Really? You work in a factory? That's cool. I'm a supervisor too, actually.
ParticipantA: Oh, really? Same thing? I guess that makes sense then.
ParticipantB: Yeah. But I don't like the show that much. My boss there, he's kind of like the guy in the show, but nicer.
ParticipantA: Hmm. I thought the show was mostly fake. People make it up a lot.
ParticipantB: Maybe. But my experience is mixed. Some days it's great, some days it's just... tough.
ParticipantA: Yeah, I feel that. Sometimes the production line is smooth, sometimes it's chaos. Hard to keep up a perfect story.
ParticipantB: Exactly. That's why I like the lighter shows more. Gives you a break.
ParticipantA: True. Just want to forget the stress for an hour.
ParticipantB: Same here. So, are our interests totally different?
ParticipantA: A little. I like the office stuff, you like the mystery/survival stuff mostly.
ParticipantB: Yeah, seems like we have different vibes. Ours is real life, theirs is... fantasy.
ParticipantA: Yeah, something like that. Okay, I think that's all I needed.
ParticipantB: Sure, thanks for calling. It was nice talking.
ParticipantA: Yep, you too. Good luck with your shifts.
ParticipantB: Thanks. Bye.
ParticipantA: Bye.
